== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]] (<code>1282_20</code>, Virtual Block 8.2), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p4-74-A_Remote_Planet.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-aremoteplanet-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11], Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Typos kept as published (“an/or”, “weapon_”).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone: treat "4" on it as "2". Your Force generation at City Outskirts is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (an/or their matching weapon_. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1282_20</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 8 set mark, original-title strip, copyright line, concept credit) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
